# Paths whose change makes a pull request run the HEAVY Rust jobs (ci.yml, output rust of the changes job).
# Every entry must also be in .github/ci-paths.txt (just check-ci-paths). A change matching only
# ci-paths.txt (workflow, justfile, scripts) runs the light CI-infrastructure jobs; a push to omp2 runs everything.
# One glob per line; ** matches across directories.

.config/**
Cargo.lock
Cargo.toml
about.toml
clippy.toml
crates/**
deny.toml
docs/py/**
examples/**
extensions/**
fixtures/**
rust-toolchain.toml
